reviews.review:
Ah, where to start. It feels like this entire game was created by AI.

==== Performance ====
Given a Ryzen 7 7800X3D and a Radeon RX 7900 XT with 32gb ram ddr5
ON FULL LOW SETTINGS
I had 62 fps.
Despite the game looking cartoonish, with the only "visual fidelity" being the default UE5 slop junk of post processing, it has nothing to go for it.

==== Quality ====
The game is not polished at all. This is why it made me feel as if it was written from scratch by AI.
The language switcher has white boxes
All objects in the game, upon hovering over them, show some sort of "red box", as if the game was in fact just a development test build.
The music is one single medieval track that loops over and over and it will drive you f**king nuts.
And the worst part: interacting with any work station such as a furnace for example, will lock you out of the game because this dumb f**king ass developer did NOT add a way to exit stations. There's no X button, no ESC interaction, nothing.

==== Originality ====
Story is classic trash AI slop. The characters aren't even voiced, they just do a "murmur" as if grunting in anger when they speak.
The textures also feel ripped out straight out of the free UE5 assets.
Despite being "BLACKSMITH SIMULATOR", you do not actually do blacksmithing at all. No heating the iron, no hammering, quenching, nothing. This is just slop AI with RPG medieval theme.

I played 5 minutes of this horrible junk (of course, stuck in the workbench) just to write this review so that no one buys it. In fact, I hope Steam removes it from the store.
You, developer, should go to prison.

f**k you.
